## CLI usage svgtofont command line options sources output

--- [svgtofont npm] ---
### svgtofont > Install > Using With Command

#### Using With Command

[](#using-with-command)

```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "font": "svgtofont --sources ./svg --output ./font --fontName uiw-font"
  },
  "svgtofont": {
    "css": {
      "fontSize": "12px"
    }
  }
}
```

You can add configuration to package.json. [#48](https://github.com/jaywcjlove/svgtofont/issues/48)

Support for `.svgtofontrc` and [more](https://github.REDACTED.md?plain=1#L106-L135) configuration files.

```js
{
  "fontName": "svgtofont",
  "css": true
}
```

```js
/**
 * @type {import('svgtofont').SvgToFontOptions}
 */
export default {
  fontName: "iconfont",
}
```

## Node API options example fontName outPath

--- [svgtofont npm] ---
### svgtofont > API

## API

[](#api)

```js
import { createSVG, createTTF, createEOT, createWOFF, createWOFF2, createSvgSymbol, copyTemplate, createHTML } from 'svgtofont/lib/utils';

const options = { ... };

async function createFont() {
  const unicodeObject = await createSVG(options); 
  const ttf = await createTTF(options); // SVG Font => TTF
  await createEOT(options, ttf); // TTF => EOT
  await createWOFF(options, ttf); // TTF => WOFF
  await createWOFF2(options, ttf); // TTF => WOFF2
  await createSvgSymbol(options); // SVG Files => SVG Symbol
}
```

### svgtofont > options > css

### css

[](#css)

> Type: `Boolean|CSSOptions`  
> Default value: `false`

Create CSS/LESS files, default `true`.

```ts
type CSSOptions = {
  /**
   * Output the css file to the specified directory
   */
  output?: string;
  /**
   * Which files are exported.
   */
  include?: RegExp;
  /**
   * Setting font size.
   */
  fontSize?: string | boolean;
  /**
   * Set the path in the css file
   * https://github.com/jaywcjlove/svgtofont/issues/48#issuecomment-739547189
   */
  cssPath?: string;
  /**
   * Set file name
   * https://github.com/jaywcjlove/svgtofont/issues/48#issuecomment-739547189
   */
  fileName?: string;
  /**
   * Ad hoc template variables.
   */
  templateVars?: Record<string, any>;
  /**
   * When including CSS files in a CSS file,
   * you can add a timestamp parameter or custom text to the file path to prevent browser caching issues and ensure style updates are applied. @default true
   * @example `path/to/iconfont.css?t=1612345678`
   */
  hasTimestamp?: boolean | string;
}
```

## useNameAsUnicode option filename unicode mapping

--- [svgtofont npm] ---
### svgtofont > options > useNameAsUnicode

### useNameAsUnicode

[](#usenameasunicode)

> Type: `Boolean`  
> Default value: `false`

should the name(file name) be used as unicode? this switch allows for the support of ligatures.

let's say you have an svg with a file name of `add` and you want to use ligatures for it. you would set up your processing as mentioned above and turn on this switch.

```js
{
  ...
  useNameAsUnicode: true
}
```

while processing, instead of using a single sequential char for the unicode, it uses the file name. using the file name as the unicode allows the following code to work as expected.

```css
.icons {
  font-family: 'your-font-icon-name' !important;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-style: normal;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}
```

```html
<i class="icons">add</i>
```

as you add more svgs and process them into your font you would just use the same pattern.

```html
<i class="icons">add</i>
<i class="icons">remove</i>
<i class="icons">edit</i>
```

--- [svgtofont npm] ---
### svgtofont > options > styleTemplates

### styleTemplates

[](#styletemplates)

> Type: `String` Default value: `undefined`

The path of the templates, see `src/styles` or `test/templates/styles` to get reference about how to create a template, file names can have the extension .template, like a `filename.scss.template`

---

## startUnicode generateInfoData custom unicode per icon

--- [svgtofont npm] ---
### svgtofont > options > generateInfoData

### generateInfoData

[](#generateinfodata)

> Type: `Boolean`  
> Default value: `false`

Output `./dist/info.json`, The content is as follows:

```js
{
  "adobe": {
    "encodedCode": "\\ea01",
    "prefix": "svgtofont",
    "className": "svgtofont-adobe",
    "unicode": "&#59905;"
  },
  ...
}
```

--- [svgtofont npm] ---
### svgtofont > options > getIconUnicode

### getIconUnicode

[](#geticonunicode)

Get Icon Unicode

```ts
getIconUnicode?: (name: string, unicode: string, startUnicode: number) 
      => [string, number];
```

{
  "file_path": "/Users/jobinlawrance/Project/raven/.worktrees/raven-icon-font/ravenlogoassets/build-font.mjs",
  "content": "import svgtofont from 'svgtofont';\nimport fs from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\n\nconst __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\n\n// Map Asset N.svg -> letter glyph (these spell RAVEN at U+0052/41/56/45/4E)\nconst ASSET_TO_LETTER = {\n  'Asset 2.svg': 'N',\n  'Asset 3.svg': 'E',\n  'Asset 4.svg': 'V',\n  'Asset 5.svg': 'A',\n  'Asset 6.svg': 'R',\n};\n\nconst stageDir = path.join(__dirname, '.svgs-staged');\nconst distDir = path.join(__dirname, 'font');\n\nfs.rmSync(stageDir, { recursive: true, force: true });\nfs.mkdirSync(stageDir);\n\nfor (const [asset, letter] of Object.entries(ASSET_TO_LETTER)) {\n  const src = path.join(__dirname, asset);\n  if (!fs.existsSync(src)) throw new Error(`Missing source SVG: ${asset}`);\n  fs.copyFileSync(src, path.join(stageDir, `${letter}.svg`));\n}\n\nawait svgtofont({\n  src: stageDir,\n  dist: distDir,\n  fontName: 'ravenicons',\n  css: { hasTimestamp: false },\n  emptyDist: true,\n  outSVGReact: true,\n  outSVGReactNative: false,\n  generateInfoData: true,\n  // Map each filename (R, A, V, E, N) to its real ASCII codepoint so that\n  // typing \"RAVEN\" in font-family: ravenicons renders the logo letters.\n  getIconUnicode: (name) => {\n    const code = name.toUpperCase().charCodeAt(0);\n    return [String.fromCharCode(code), code + 1];\n  },\n});\n\nfs.rmSync(stageDir, { recursive: true, force: true });\nconsole.log('Done.');\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Users/jobinlawrance/Project/raven/.worktrees/raven-icon-font/ravenlogoassets/README.md",
  "content": "# Raven logo assets\n\nSource SVGs for the Raven wordmark + bird, plus a generated icon font (`ravenicons`)\nthat renders the wordmark by typing the literal characters `RAVEN`.\n\n## Layout\n\n```\nravenlogoassets/\n├── Asset 2.svg … Asset 6.svg   # source glyphs for R A V E N (see mapping below)\n├── logo/                       # bird logo SVGs (Asset 7, 8, 11, 12)\n├── build-font.mjs              # regenerates font/ from the Asset *.svg files\n├── package.json                # pins svgtofont\n└── font/                       # generated — commit alongside source\n    ├── ravenicons.{woff2,woff,ttf,eot,svg}\n    ├── ravenicons.symbol.svg   # SVG sprite for <use xlink:href>\n    ├── ravenicons.{css,scss,less,module.less,styl}\n    ├── react/                  # React components (one per glyph)\n    ├── info.json               # codepoint manifest\n    └── preview.html            # open in a browser to verify rendering\n```\n\n## Glyph → codepoint map\n\nEach source SVG is wired to its real ASCII codepoint, so any element using\n`font-family: ravenicons` will render the wordmark when the text is `RAVEN`:\n\n| Letter | Codepoint | Source        |\n| ------ | --------- | ------------- |\n| R      | `U+0052`  | `Asset 6.svg` |\n| A      | `U+0041`  | `Asset 5.svg` |\n| V      | `U+0056`  | `Asset 4.svg` |\n| E      | `U+0045`  | `Asset 3.svg` |\n| N      | `U+004E`  | `Asset 2.svg` |\n\n## Using the font\n\n### Plain HTML / CSS\n\n```html\n<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/path/to/font/ravenicons.css\" />\n<span style=\"font-family: 'ravenicons'; font-size: 8rem;\">RAVEN</span>\n```\n\nThe `ravenicons.css` file declares the `@font-face` and per-glyph helper\nclasses (`.ravenicons-R`, `.ravenicons-A`, `.ravenicons-V`, `.ravenicons-E`,\n`.ravenicons-N`) that emit the glyph via `::before`.\n\n### Vue 3 (frontend/)\n\nImport the CSS once (e.g. in `src/main.ts` or your global stylesheet):\n\n```ts\nimport 'ravenlogoassets/font/ravenicons.css';\n```\n\nThen anywhere in a template:\n\n```vue\n<span class=\"raven-logo\">RAVEN</span>\n\n<style scoped>\n.raven-logo {\n  font-family: 'ravenicons';\n  font-size: 6rem;\n  letter-spacing: 0.05em;\n}\n</style>\n```\n\n### React\n\nEither import the generated component:\n\n```tsx\nimport { R, A, V, E, N } from 'ravenlogoassets/font/react';\n```\n\n…or use the same CSS approach with the `font-family` set to `ravenicons`.\n\n### SVG sprite (no font load)\n\n```html\n<svg><use xlink:href=\"font/ravenicons.symbol.svg#ravenicons-R\" /></svg>\n```\n\n## Regenerating the font\n\n```bash\ncd ravenlogoassets\nnpm install            # one-time, installs svgtofont\nnode build-font.mjs    # regenerates font/ from Asset *.svg\n```\n\nThe build script:\n\n1. Stages `Asset 2.svg … Asset 6.svg` into a temp dir under their letter names.\n2. Runs `svgtofont` with `getIconUnicode` set so each glyph maps to its real\n   ASCII codepoint (not the default Private Use Area).\n3. Cleans up the staging dir.\n\nOutput is deterministic — `hasTimestamp: false` keeps CSS diffs stable across\nrebuilds.\n\n## Adding or replacing a glyph\n\n1. Drop the new SVG into this directory as `Asset N.svg`.\n2. Add an entry to `ASSET_TO_LETTER` in `build-font.mjs` mapping it to a letter.\n3. Run `node build-font.mjs`.\n4. Commit the source SVG and the regenerated `font/` together.\n\n## Visual smoke-test\n\nOpen `font/preview.html` in any browser — you should see the wordmark\nrendered at 12rem, then individual letters via the helper classes.\n"
}

4c566282e4e673bbbff81b5a85621eb06be25cf0

feat(brand): add ravenicons font built from Raven logo assets

Generates an icon font from the wordmark SVGs (Asset 2–6) where each
glyph is mapped to its real ASCII codepoint, so any element using
`font-family: ravenicons` renders the logo when the text is "RAVEN".

- ravenlogoassets/Asset 2–6.svg — source wordmark glyphs (R, A, V, E, N)
- ravenlogoassets/logo/         — bird logo SVGs (Asset 7, 8, 11, 12)
- ravenlogoassets/build-font.mjs — deterministic build via svgtofont
- ravenlogoassets/font/         — generated font (woff2, woff, ttf, eot,
  svg, symbol sprite, css/scss/less, react components, info.json)
- README documenting glyph mapping, usage in Vue/React/HTML, and how to
  regenerate or extend the font

Signed-off-by: Jobin Lawrance <jobinlawrance@gmail.com>
